section_summary.extract_value: This section details the Loneliness Questionnaire (LQ), an 11-item scale with emotional and social loneliness subscales, used to measure perceived loneliness. Responses are rated on a 5-point Likert scale, with negatively formulated items reverse-coded to yield an average total score from 1 to 5, where higher scores indicate greater loneliness. The Cronbach's alpha for the total score in the current study was .94, indicating high reliability.
